title: My phone keeps taking photos of me sleeping 📸
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 4:44 in the morning my phone showed a new photo of me sleeping.

scenes.narration: At 4:44 in the morning my phone showed a new photo of me sleeping.
I live alone. The photo was taken from the foot of my bed. The timestamp said 4:43. One minute ago.
I opened the gallery. Hundreds. One every night, going back months. All of me, asleep. All from different corners of the room.
Each one was a little closer. The first from the doorway. The newest from beside my pillow.
I did not scream. My throat would not let me. I only stared at the dark corner by the door, where the first photo was taken from, and where the shadow had a slightly different shape every night.
I zoomed into the newest. In the black window, a reflection. A person holding my phone, steady, and patient.
The person wore my watch. My pyjama sleeve. I looked down at my own wrists. Bare. And the phone buzzed again. A new photo, from beside my pillow. And in it, my eyes were open.
So tell me. Do you stay awake, or sleep?
